name: Sheraton 27K, 2BDR
headline: The 2 BDR Sapphire Condo K | 5 min to CAI Airport
summary: The trendy and colorful apartment sleeps 4 guests comfortably. The apartment has 1 closed bedroom, 1 glass bedroom, a small full bathroom and a kitchenette. It is fully equipped with all the amenities needed to make your stay unique and memorable and is managed by Xuru Stays.

description.Space:
The apartment features 2 bedrooms, one of which is a glass bedroom and 1 full bathroom, with a spacious colorful living room that is furnished with a couch, a dining  table and a fully equipped kitchenette featuring a Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, cooking utensils, microwave and a hot plate for cooking. There is cable and smart TV to stream your favorite content along with fast and reliable Wifi.
There bedrooms feature queen size beds.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is packed with cafés and restaurants. 
This neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- There is a sports complex for most sports activities (running track, football, basketball, squash, tennis..) which is a 10 min walk from the apartment. 


- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit: All places are reachable by car and Uber but if you want take a walk it's not going to take you more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.
description.Notes: Please note that additional unreported guests are not allowed to access or enter the property.

• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Customer service is amazing, apartment was nice. Very close to the airport!

We were very happy with the quality of the accommodation and our experience. However, there were a couple of minor inconveniences:

The living room furniture showed signs of wear, with discoloration and stains. It's understandable in a high-traffic setting like Airbnb, but when replaced, a darker color might be a better choice.

The washer/dryer unit didn’t dry clothes effectively, so we had to hang them to air-dry.

We stayed from February 4th to March 4th with three people, and we needed an extra set of keys, which were delivered the same day—impressive and appreciated.

We also really liked how Xuru Stays approached customer service. Their response was quick, friendly, and effective, which made our stay even more enjoyable.

Overall, the experience was pleasant. We would recommend Xuru Stays for a hassle-free, clean, and modern stay in Heliopolis.
